}}'''Derne''' is the captain of the ''[[Swift (ship)|Swift]]''.

==Appearance==
Captain Derne is square-faced.

==Activities==
[[Mat]] hires his ship in [[Aringill]] to get to [[Tear]] because it is fast. Mat and [[Thom]] are chasing [[Comar]] before he can kill [[Egwene]], [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]]. He pays gold for the passage and more on arrival.{{ref/book|3|49}}
